source: WCAG 2.2 and WCAG 2.1 success criteria, plus patterns common in React and Material-UI code
title: Additional WCAG 2.2, WCAG 2.1 and React checks
notes: WCAG 2.2 (October 2023) adds nine success criteria; 4.1.1 Parsing was removed. WCAG 2.2 AA is the current target for most public-sector sites.
Section 508 (revised) incorporates WCAG 2.0 only, so criteria added in 2.1 and 2.2 are marked 'not required by 508' in this report; they are still needed for WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
These rows are in addition to the Mass.gov checklist. The same rule applies: no findings is not a pass.

items.text: Pointer targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or have enough spacing.
items.manual_test: Measure small icon buttons, close buttons, pagination and table actions in the browser; use axe DevTools target-size (WCAG 2.2 ruleset) or Accessibility Insights.

items.text: Focused elements are not hidden by sticky headers, footers or cookie banners.
items.manual_test: Tab through a long page with sticky elements and confirm each focused control is at least partly visible; also check at 200% and 400% zoom.

items.text: Authentication does not need a memory or cognitive test: paste and password managers work, and any CAPTCHA has an alternative.
items.manual_test: On login, reset and sign-up forms paste a password, use a password manager and complete the flow without solving a puzzle or retyping characters.

items.text: Information already entered in a multi-step process is not requested again.
items.manual_test: Complete wizards and checkouts; data entered earlier must be pre-filled or selectable, except where re-entry is essential (such as confirming a password).

items.text: Drag and drop has a single-pointer alternative.
items.manual_test: For every drag interaction (sorting, file upload, boards) confirm a click, button or keyboard alternative exists.

items.text: Help (contact, chat, FAQ) is in the same place on every page.
items.manual_test: Compare the position of help or contact links across several pages.

items.text: Focus is not entirely hidden behind author content (2.4.11 is AA; 2.4.12 enhanced is AAA).
items.manual_test: Covered by W02; check overlays, drawers and chat widgets too.

items.text: Fields that collect personal data have an autocomplete token.
items.manual_test: Check name, email, phone, address and password fields use valid autocomplete values (jsx-a11y autocomplete-valid or axe autocomplete-valid).

items.text: Text stays readable when line, letter, word and paragraph spacing is increased.
items.manual_test: Apply the WCAG text spacing bookmarklet or Accessibility Insights check and confirm no text is clipped or overlaps.

items.text: Content shown on hover or focus (tooltips, menus) can be dismissed, hovered over and stays until dismissed.
items.manual_test: Hover and focus each tooltip or popover: Escape must close it, the pointer can move onto it, and it does not vanish on its own.

items.text: Content is not locked to portrait or landscape.
items.manual_test: Rotate a device or emulator; all content and functions must remain.

items.text: Text can be resized to 200% without assistive technology.
items.manual_test: See M43 and M44.

items.text: Time limits, auto-refresh, carousels and moving content can be paused, stopped or extended.
items.manual_test: Wait on each page; session timeouts must warn and allow extension, and moving content longer than 5 seconds needs a pause control.

items.text: Animation respects the reduced-motion setting.
items.manual_test: Turn on 'reduce motion' in the operating system; parallax, large transitions and auto-playing animation must stop or simplify.

items.text: The accessible name of a control contains its visible label.
items.manual_test: Use voice control and say the visible label; ANDI's links/buttons module shows the accessible name.

items.text: Clickable divs and spans are real buttons or have a role, tabindex and key handler.
items.manual_test: Tab to every clickable thing and activate it with Enter or Space.

items.text: Icon-only buttons (IconButton, Fab, ToggleButton) have an accessible name.
items.manual_test: Tab to each icon button with a screen reader; it must announce its purpose, not just 'button'.

items.text: Dialogs, modals and drawers have a name and manage focus (move in, trap, return).
items.manual_test: See M46 to M48. Check Escape closes the dialog and the background is inert.

items.text: Toasts, snackbars and inline notifications are announced.
items.manual_test: Trigger each message with a screen reader running; it must be announced without moving focus.

items.text: Data grids (ag-Grid, MUI DataGrid) are keyboard operable with headers and names.
items.manual_test: Navigate cells with arrow keys, edit, sort and select rows by keyboard; check header and cell announcements.

items.text: No duplicate ids and no positive tabindex values.
items.manual_test: Confirm tab order still follows reading order after removing tabindex values.
